breeze.cockpit: the pod at the front of the chest
breeze.name: Breeze
breeze.note: Retired (owner, 2026-10-24: "Breeze me h sucks"); kept while the game still loads it.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.note: Mining Mike's Uber mech, ported: the reference.
bulwark.weapons: slab shield and siege fist (L), breaker cannon (R)

foreman.cockpit: Panorama: seated behind one wide screen and square side screens, in the chamfered prow
foreman.legs: digitigrade, three segments, double hydraulic rams, track-pad feet
foreman.name: Foreman
foreman.note: Original, after an excavator: slewing ring, broad shoulders with beacons, an engine pack and its stack. Recommended.
foreman.opening: the Panorama clamshell, chest and cockpit as one: the front under the screens drops into a step, then the front over them swings up and out on two rams with the dash

ironhorse.cockpit: Excavator cab: seated, floor-to-roof screens in two rows and one in the floor
ironhorse.legs: digitigrade, drive-wheel knees with coupling rods, cow-catcher shins
ironhorse.name: Ironhorse
ironhorse.note: Original, after a steam locomotive: a banded boiler torso, smokestack, dome, headlamp, firebox pack.
ironhorse.opening: the dogs swing off, the smokebox front drops forward as a ramp with the cab's front on it

ravager.cockpit: low head, visor under three eyes
ravager.name: Ravager
ravager.note: Mining Mike's rival Uber mech, ported: the reference.

stevedore.cockpit: harness: standing in the octagonal prow
stevedore.name: Stevedore
stevedore.note: Original, after a dock crane: gantry, counter-jib and weights, warning lamps.
stevedore.opening: the four lock rods turn out, the prow splits into two doors
stevedore.weapons: cargo mortar (L), crane jib with a harpoon grapple (R)
